'''Gorbek Fask''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

He had worked increasingly more with the Alliance. Fask had several contacts within [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gorbek Fask is one of the pre-generated characters from the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]].
